responsibility: This header declares the public interface to GCC’s OpenMP HSA gridification support. It exposes the helper that builds the lastprivate completion predicate for a gridified omp_for_data loop nest and the entry point that walks a GIMPLE body to convert eligible target constructs into gridified GPU-kernel form, serving as the bridge between the generic OpenMP lowering code and the HSA-specific grid transformation implemented in omp-grid.c.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the omp-grid pair: it only exposes the public entry points for gridification and gridified lastprivate predicate construction to other OpenMP lowering code, whereas gcc/omp-grid.c provides the HSA-specific transformation and analysis implementation behind those APIs.
